history: Found as a CRASH at EIGHTY-TWO nested parentheses. _bin walks eight precedence tiers, so each level of nesting cost eight Python frames plus _unary and _primary against a default recursion limit of 1000, and the RecursionError escaped as a crash. canonical.py treats exactly this failure as a defect and converts it -- json.loads' RecursionError becomes a WireFormatError -- while the compiler front end had no equivalent and the grammar stated no nesting limit to refuse against. Now it states one.
note: Expression nesting is bounded and the bound is diagnosed. 47 levels compile; 48 and beyond are refused.
